module: Third-party library lustache: Mustache rendering context. A context wraps the current view (data table), keeps a link to the parent context (section nesting stack) and a name-resolution cache. The renderer uses it to resolve `{{name}}`, `{{a.b.c}}` and `{{.}}`.
notes: The methods are called with a colon on an instance created by `Context:new(view, parent)`; `new` returns a table whose metatable is `context` itself.

Minor bug: `lookup` tests `string_find(name, ".") > 0`; the pattern "." matches any character, so the condition is always true for a non-empty name and the dot-split path is always taken (the result remains correct).
`false` or nil values are not cached effectively (the `if not value` test restarts the lookup) and the lookup then goes up to the parent contexts.

__index.desc: Self-reference of the class (the `context` table serves as metatable).

new.desc: Creates a context for `view` with an optional parent and an empty cache.

view.desc: Context data (table, number or other value).

push.desc: Creates a child context for `view` whose parent is the current context (entering a section).

lookup.desc: Resolves a name in the current view, then, failing that, in the parent contexts. Handles dotted paths (`a.b.c`) and the name `.` (the view itself). The result is cached.

clear_cache.desc: Clears the resolution cache of this context.
